_comment: AWS Secrets Manager: hope/${ENV}/services — internal service-to-service tokens. An EMPTY *_SERVICE_TOKEN puts the X-Service-Token middleware into DEV-BYPASS MODE (rule 06 §Gateway Integration & Auth). Generate real values for EVERY AWS environment, dev included. HOPE uses ONE shared internal service token set by devops; X-Tenant-Id is mandatory alongside it on every tenant-scoped internal call.
